analysis.title: SXXP Earnings — Week Ahead 2–6 November 2026
key_insights: 93 SXXP companies, about 13% of the index by market cap, report in the week of 2-6 November 2026. The calendar is lighter than the prior week in both reporter count and market-cap coverage.
Reporting builds through Tuesday and Wednesday and peaks Thursday, when 46 names, almost half the week's calendar, report.
Communication Services has the largest sector exposure, with about 43% of sector market cap reporting, almost entirely on Thursday. Deutsche Telekom anchors that session.
National Grid and Engie put Utilities in focus, with about 28% of the European sector reporting over the week.
Industrials has the most reporters by count: 23 names covering about 15% of sector market cap, including Rheinmetall on Thursday.
In Healthcare, Novo Nordisk reports Wednesday and Siemens Healthineers Thursday, with about 18% of the sector reporting overall.
US read-across: Apple and Palantir report Monday, AMD Tuesday and Qualcomm Wednesday. AI spending and data-centre infrastructure are the key themes to watch.
Thursday's Utilities focus extends to the US, where substantial sector exposure reports alongside the European names. Amgen and Pfizer on Tuesday give Healthcare context ahead of Novo Nordisk.
Daily counts: Monday 2 names, Tuesday 17, Wednesday 21, Thursday 46, Friday 7. Friday's European reporters are mostly Financials and Industrials.
earnings_insights: Week of 2-6 Nov 2026: 93 SXXP companies (about 13% of index market cap) scheduled to report. These are scheduled dates, not results.
Key European reporters: Ferrari (Tuesday), Novo Nordisk (Wednesday), Deutsche Telekom, National Grid, Engie, Rheinmetall and Siemens Healthineers (Thursday).
Key US reporters named as read-across: Apple and Palantir (Monday), AMD, Arista Networks, Amgen and Pfizer (Tuesday), Qualcomm (Wednesday).
